CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app.appointment_json(p_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'id', a.id, 'customerId', a.customer_id, 'serviceId', a.service_id, 'serviceName', a.service_name,
    'categoryId', a.category_key, 'staffId', a.staff_id, 'staffName', a.staff_name,
    'start', app.to_wall(a.starts_at, t.time_zone), 'durationMinutes', a.duration_minutes,
    'priceEur', a.price_eur,
    'status', case when a.status = 'confirmed' and a.ends_at < now() then 'completed' else a.status::text end,
    'payment', a.payment::text, 'createdAt', a.created_at)
  from public.appointments a join public.tenants t on t.id = a.tenant_id
  where a.id = p_id
$function$

functions.name: audit_immutable
functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app.audit_immutable()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  -- einzige Ausnahme: der ganze Tenant wird entfernt (Kaskade)
  if tg_op = 'DELETE' and not exists (select 1 from public.tenants t where t.id = old.tenant_id) then
    return old;
  end if;
  raise exception 'crm_audit_log ist unveränderlich' using errcode = 'P0001';
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app.current_tenant()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select d.tenant_id
  from public.tenant_domains d
  where d.host = app.request_host()
     or (d.is_pattern and app.request_host() like replace(replace(d.host, '_', '\_'), '*', '%'))
  order by d.is_pattern, length(d.host) desc
  limit 1
$function$

functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app.default_pref(p_kind text, p_channel text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select case
    when p_channel = 'inapp' then true
    when p_kind = 'reminder' then p_channel = 'email'
    when p_kind = 'chat' then p_channel in ('push', 'email')
    when p_kind = 'waitlist' then p_channel in ('push', 'sms', 'email')

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app.find_link_suggestions(p_customer uuid)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_c public.customers;
  v_n int := 0;
begin
  select * into v_c from public.customers where id = p_customer;
  if v_c.id is null or v_c.user_id is null then return 0; end if;
  insert into public.link_suggestions (tenant_id, portal_customer_id, legacy_customer_id, matched_by)
  select v_c.tenant_id, v_c.id, l.id,
         array_remove(array[
           case when v_c.email is not null and lower(l.email) = lower(v_c.email) then 'email' end,
           case when app.phone_e164(l.phone) is not null and app.phone_e164(l.phone) = app.phone_e164(v_c.phone) then 'phone' end
         ], null)
  from public.customers l
  where l.tenant_id = v_c.tenant_id and l.user_id is null and l.id <> v_c.id and l.deletion_requested_at is null
    and lower(btrim(l.first_name)) = lower(btrim(v_c.first_name))
    and lower(btrim(l.last_name)) = lower(btrim(v_c.last_name))
    and ((v_c.email is not null and lower(l.email) = lower(v_c.email))
         or (app.phone_e164(l.phone) is not null and app.phone_e164(l.phone) = app.phone_e164(v_c.phone)))
  on conflict (portal_customer_id, legacy_customer_id) do nothing;
  get diagnostics v_n = row_count;
  return v_n;
end
$function$

 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql

AS $function$
  select case
    when p is null or regexp_replace(p, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') = '' then null
    when btrim(p) like '+%' then '+' || regexp_replace(p, '[^0-9]', '', 'g')
    when regexp_replace(p, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') like '00%' then '+' || substr(regexp_replace(p, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 3)
    when regexp_replace(p, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') like '0%' then '+43' || substr(regexp_replace(p, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 2)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.svc_queue_claim(p_limit integer DEFAULT 50)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_rows jsonb;
begin
  with due as (
    select q.id from public.notification_queue q
    where q.status = 'queued' and q.not_before <= now() and q.attempts < 5
    order by q.id limit p_limit for update skip locked
  ), upd as (
    update public.notification_queue q set status = 'sending', attempts = q.attempts + 1
    from due where q.id = due.id returning q.*
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id', u.id, 'channel', u.channel, 'kind', u.kind, 'payload', u.payload, 'tenantId', u.tenant_id,
    'customer', (select jsonb_build_object('email', c.email, 'phone', c.phone, 'language', c.language, 'firstName', c.first_name)
                 from public.customers c where c.id = u.customer_id),
    'push', case when u.channel = 'push' then (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('endpoint', s.endpoint,
                 'p256dh', s.p256dh, 'auth', s.auth)), '[]'::jsonb) from public.push_subscriptions s where s.customer_id = u.customer_id) end
  )), '[]'::jsonb) into v_rows from upd u;
  return v_rows;
end

functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.svc_queue_done(p_id bigint, p_status text, p_error text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  update public.notification_queue set
    status = case when p_status = 'retry' then 'queued' else p_status end,
    not_before = case when p_status = 'retry' then now() + make_interval(mins => 2 * attempts) else not_before end,
    last_error = left(p_error, 500),
    sent_at = case when p_status = 'sent' then now() else sent_at end
  where id = p_id
